observation.visible_scene: A tan floor covered with several long, serpentine rows of upright rectangular blocks (dominoes), each row a different color: yellow and orange on the left, a green wavy line, a purple line, a pink/red line, a teal/blue line, and an orange line on the right. Behind them is a white wall with a vertical-slatted radiator and two electrical outlets near the top.
visible_changes: The colored block rows remain standing and keep the same shape and orientation relative to one another throughout the excerpt; no block tilts, falls, or changes position within the arrangement.

The whole scene content (block rows, baseboard, wall, outlets, radiator) drifts uniformly toward the right edge of the frame over time (e.g., the yellow row's right end moves from ~x220 to ~x300, the green row's left edge from ~x210 to ~x280, the outlets from ~x330 to ~x405), with a minor vertical shift, indicating camera pan/translation rather than object motion.
No gap opens in any row and no toppling front is visible; the configuration is static between first and last frames apart from the camera-induced shift.
outside_clip_unknowns: Any trigger, operator, or mechanism that might start a domino cascade, and whether a fall begins before or after this segment.
The intended direction or completion of any collapse, since none occurs within the excerpt.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent rightward drift is a pure horizontal pan, a slight dolly/zoom, or a combination; the uniform translation of all elements is consistent with camera motion, but the exact camera path is not determinable from the background alone.
Whether the blocks are merely arranged for display or are set up to fall; no motion of the blocks themselves is observable here.
